properties.managing_authority: Parques Nacionales Naturales de Colombia; Autoridad Nacional de Pesca y Acuicultura
properties.purpose: To sustainably and responsibly exploit the populations of straddling, highly migratory, demersal, and other species with fishing potential in the oceanic zone located west of the Yuruparí and Malpelo ridges in the Colombian Pacific, as a mechanism to contribute to the economic and social development of national fishing activities and as a strategy to help guarantee the country's food security and the conservation of fishery resources. To conserve and understand the ecosystems and species distributed in the oceanic zone located west of the Yuruparí and Malpelo ridges, as a strategy to conserve the national marine natural heritage in the Eastern Tropical Pacific. To contribute to the ecosystem connectivity of the Eastern Tropical Pacific, as a contribution to the environmental management of the marine territory and to complement other strategies for the conservation of regional biodiversity.
properties.restrictions: Activities other than those of sustainable use, preservation, restoration, knowledge and enjoyment are prohibited
properties.allowed: Activities in accordance with the restrictions are allowed.
properties.regulation_titles: Resolución 1908 de septiembre 14, 2017 (Original resolution declaring the management area); Resolución 0670 de junio 28, 2022 (expansion of Yurupari)
properties.species_of_concern: Hawksbill Turtle (Eretmochelys imbricata); Scalloped Hammerhead (Sphyrna lewini); Whale Shark (Rhincodon typus); Green Turtle (Chelonia mydas); Common Thresher Shark (Alopias vulpinus); Bigeye Thresher Shark (Alopias superciliosus); Pelagic Thresher Shark (Alopias pelagicus); Oceanic Whitetip Shark (Carcharhinus longimanus); Giant Manta Ray (Mobula birostris); Bigeye Tuna (Thunnus obesus); Leatherback Turtle (Dermochelys coriacea); Sperm Whale (Physeter macrocephalus); Yellowfin Tuna (Thunnus albacares); Skipjack Tuna (Katsuwonus pelamis); Dorado / Mahi-mahi (Coryphaena hippurus); Wahoo (Acanthocybium solandri); Blue Marlin (Makaira nigricans); White Marlin (Kajikia albida); Striped Marlin (Kajikia audax); Sailfish (Istiophorus platypterus)
properties.boundary_source: Registro Unico Nacional de Areas Protegidas
